## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/tree-view`.

### `TreeViewComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-tree-view`  
**Type parameters:** `T`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables CSS transitions when nodes expand or collapse. Accepts the attribute form (`animate="false"`). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `""` | Accessible name of the tree. Describe what the tree represents; it also names the filter input ("Filter {name}"). Set this or `ariaLabelledBy`: an unnamed tree logs a warning in development. A plain `aria-label` attribute on `mona-tree-view` doesn't name the tree. |
| `ariaLabelledBy` | `string` | `""` | Id of the element that names the tree, as an alternative to `ariaLabel`. |
| `children` | `ChildrenSelector<T>` | `""` | Property name or accessor used to derive a node's children from a data item. Accepts a property name, a function returning the children, or a function returning an observable of the children. |
| `data` | `Iterable<T>` | `[]` | Collection of items to render. |
| `hasChildren` | `Predicate<T> \| null` | `null` | Predicate that determines whether a node has children. Required when the children selector returns an observable. |
| `idField` | `string` | `""` | Property name that holds a node's unique identifier. Required when `mode` is set to `"flat"`. |
| `mode` | `DataStructure` | `"hierarchical"` | Shape of the source data: `"hierarchical"` for nested items via `children`, or `"flat"` for a flat list linked by `idField` and `parentIdField`. |
| `parentIdField` | `string` | `""` | Property name that holds a node's parent identifier. Required when `mode` is set to `"flat"`. |
| `textField` | `string \| Selector<T, string>` | `""` | Property name or accessor used to derive the display text from a data item. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blur` | `FocusEvent` | Emitted when the tree-view loses focus. |
| `childrenLoadError` | `ChildrenLoadErrorEvent<T>` | Emitted when the children observable of a node errors. The node is collapsed again and marked as failed (its expander reads "Retry loading {node}"), the failure is announced, and expanding the node retries the load. |
| `focus` | `FocusEvent` | Emitted when the tree-view gains focus. |
| `nodeClick` | `NodeClickEvent<T>` | Emitted when a node is clicked. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `moveNode(source: NodeItem<T>, target: NodeItem<T>, position: DropPosition): NodeMoveSnapshot \| null` | Moves a node in the tree's internal structure, without going through `data`. |
| `undoMoveNode(snapshot: NodeMoveSnapshot): void` | Reverts a move previously performed by `moveNode`. |

### `TreeViewCheckableDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-tree-view[monaTreeViewCheckable]`  
**Exported as:** `monaTreeViewCheckable`  
**Type parameters:** `T`, `K = T`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checkBy` | `NodeKeySelector<T, K> \| undefined` | `""` | Property name or accessor used to derive a node's check key from its data. Falls back to the node's data when unset. |
| `checkedKeys` | `Iterable<K>` | `[]` | Keys of the currently checked nodes. |
| `hasCheckbox` | `((data: T, uid: string) => boolean) \| null` | `null` | Predicate that determines whether a node displays a checkbox. When unset, every node displays a checkbox. |
| `monaTreeViewCheckable` | `Partial<CheckableOptions> \| ""` | `""` | Configures check mode and whether checking a node also checks its children or parents. Merged over `{ checkChildren: true, checkDisabledChildren: false, checkParents: true, childrenOnly: false, enabled: true, mode: "multiple" }` when applied bare. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checkedKeysChange` | `K[]` | Emitted with the checked keys when the user checks or unchecks a node, including the children and parents that check follows (`checkChildren`, `checkParents`). Not emitted for keys set through `checkedKeys`, nor for keys the tree derives on its own: checked parents of checked children set from code, lazily loaded children of a checked node, and ancestors after a drop. Those are reported with the next user change. |
| `nodeCheck` | `NodeCheckEvent<T>` | Emitted when a node is checked or unchecked. |

### `TreeViewExpandableDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-tree-view[monaTreeViewExpandable]`  
**Exported as:** `monaTreeViewExpandable`  
**Type parameters:** `T`, `K = T`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expandBy` | `NodeKeySelector<T, K> \| undefined` | `""` | Property name or accessor used to derive a node's expand key from its data. Falls back to the node's data when unset. |
| `expandedKeys` | `Iterable<K>` | `[]` | Keys of the currently expanded nodes. |
| `monaTreeViewExpandable` | `Partial<ExpandableOptions> \| ""` | `""` | Configures whether expanding and collapsing nodes is enabled. Merged over `{ enabled: true }` when applied bare. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `collapse` | `NodeItem<T>` | Emitted when a node is collapsed. |
| `expand` | `NodeItem<T>` | Emitted when a node is expanded. |
| `expandedKeysChange` | `K[]` | Emitted with the expanded keys when the user expands or collapses a node. Not emitted for keys set through `expandedKeys`, nor for the expansion a filter applies (which is undone when the filter is cleared). |

### `TreeViewSelectableDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-tree-view[monaTreeViewSelectable]`  
**Exported as:** `monaTreeViewSelectable`  
**Type parameters:** `T`, `K = T`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monaTreeViewSelectable` | `Partial<SelectableOptions> \| ""` | `""` | Configures selection mode, toggleability, and whether only child nodes are selectable. Merged over `{ childrenOnly: false, enabled: true, mode: "single", toggleable: false }` when applied bare. |
| `selectBy` | `NodeKeySelector<T, K> \| undefined` | `""` | Property name or accessor used to derive a node's selection key from its data. Falls back to the node's data when unset. |
| `selectedKeys` | `Iterable<K>` | `[]` | Keys of the currently selected nodes. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nodeSelect` | `NodeSelectEvent<T>` | Emitted before the user selects or deselects a node, by click or Enter. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the selection as it is; `selectionChange` follows when it isn't prevented. |
| `selectedKeysChange` | `K[]` | Emitted with the selected keys when the user selects or deselects a node. Not emitted for keys set through `selectedKeys`. |
| `selectionChange` | `NodeItem<T>` | Emitted with the node after the user selects or deselects it (after a `nodeSelect` that wasn't prevented). |

The tree doesn't move the node: the handler applies the move (with `moveTreeNode`, `moveFlatTreeNode` or `event.treeView.moveNode`). Call `preventDefault()` when the move isn't applied. |

### `TreeViewFilterableDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-tree-view[monaTreeViewFilterable]`  
**Exported as:** `monaTreeViewFilterable`  
**Type parameters:** `T`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` (two-way) | `string` | `""` | Current filter text used to narrow the visible nodes. Two-way bindable (`[(filter)]`); the user's typing updates it, so setting it from code (including back to `""`) always applies. |
| `filterPlaceholder` | `string` | `""` | Placeholder text shown in the filter input. |
| `monaTreeViewFilterable` | `Partial<FilterableOptions> \| ""` | `""` | Configures the filter operator, case sensitivity, and debounce delay. Merged over `{ enabled: true, operator: "contains", caseSensitive: false, debounce: 0 }` when applied bare. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filterChange` | `string` | Emitted when `filter` changes. |
| `filterInput` | `FilterChangeEvent` | Emitted when the user types in the filter input, before the filter applies. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the current filter; otherwise `filterChange` reports the new text. |

### `TreeViewNodeTemplateDirective`

Template for each node's content. The data item is the template's implicit value (`let-dataItem`) and the node's
element is `element`. Bind the tree view's data to `monaTreeViewNodeTemplateOf` to type the data item; without it,
the data item is `any` in templates.

**Selector:** `ng-template[monaTreeViewNodeTemplate]`  
**Type parameters:** `T = any`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monaTreeViewNodeTemplateOf` | `Iterable<T> \| null \| undefined` | `null` | The tree view's data, used only to type the template's data item. Optional. |

#### Template context

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$implicit` | `T` | The node's data item (`let-dataItem`). |
| `element` | `HTMLElement` | The node's element (`let-element="element"`). |

### `moveFlatTreeNode`

Moves a node within a generic flat tree structure that uses parentId references.

```typescript
function moveFlatTreeNode<T extends object>(treeData: Iterable<T>, event: NodeDropEvent<T>, idKey: keyof T, parentIdKey: keyof T): T[];
```

### `moveTreeNode`

Moves a node within a generic hierarchical tree structure.

```typescript
function moveTreeNode<T extends object>(treeData: Iterable<T>, event: NodeDropEvent<T>, idKey: keyof T, childrenKey: keyof T): T[];
```

#### `CheckableOptions`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checkChildren?` | `boolean` | Determines whether checking a node should also check its children. Only applicable when `mode` is set to `multiple`. |
| `checkDisabledChildren?` | `boolean` | Determines whether checking a node should also check its disabled children. Only applicable when `mode` is set to `multiple`. |
| `checkParents?` | `boolean` | Determines whether checking a node should also check its parents. Only applicable when `mode` is set to `multiple`. |
| `childrenOnly?` | `boolean` | Determines whether only the children of the node should be checkable. |
| `enabled?` | `boolean` | Determines if the checkboxes are enabled. |
| `mode?` | `"multiple" \| "single"` | Specifies the check mode. |

#### `ChildrenLoadErrorEvent`

Reports that the children of a node couldn't be loaded from an asynchronous children selector. The node is
collapsed again, and expanding it retries the load.

**Type parameters:** `T`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `error` (read-only) | `unknown` | What the children observable errored with. |
| `node` (read-only) | `NodeItem<T>` | The node whose children failed to load. |

#### `DisableOptions`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `disableChildren` | `boolean` | Determines whether the children of the node should be disabled as well. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | Determines if the disabling is enabled. |

#### `MonaTreeViewMessages`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/i18n`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `collapse` (read-only) | `string` |  |
| `expand` (read-only) | `string` |  |
| `filter` (read-only) | `string` | **Deprecated.** No longer rendered; the filter input's name comes from `filterLabel`. |
| `filterTree` (read-only) | `string` | Accessible name of the filter input when the tree view has no `aria-label`. |
| `noData` (read-only) | `string` | Shown, and describes the tree, when the tree view has no data. |
| `noMatches` (read-only) | `string` | Shown, describes the tree and is announced, when no node matches the filter. |

**Methods**

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filterLabel(tree: string): string` | Accessible name of the filter input, from the tree view's name ("Filter Files"). |
| `loadError(node: string): string` | Announced, and read with the node, when a node's children couldn't be loaded. |
| `loadingNode(node: string): string` | Announced while a node's children take a while to load, and the expander's name meanwhile. |
| `movedAfter(node: string, target: string): string` | Announced when a keyboard move (Ctrl+Shift+Arrow) put a node after another node. |
| `movedBefore(node: string, target: string): string` | Announced when a keyboard move put a node before another node. |
| `movedInto(node: string, target: string): string` | Announced when a keyboard move put a node inside another node, as its last child. |
| `results(count: number): string` | Announced after the user filters, with the number of nodes that match. |
| `retryLoading(node: string): string` | Name of the expander of a node whose children couldn't be loaded. |
